subject: A good vote
author: thephilofwar
body:
I was yearning to vote for PS2 since it's where I started and have most of my time playing, though Suffur is right--the 360 is far better for Revenge. I voted for 360 (less traffic check bugs, no distance bugs, no cheats, no quitters glitch, better graphics, persistent rivals, etc.), though I wish they would've kept the old skill ranking system instead of a combined World Rank.

__________

This is the truth that I am revealing before you! Behold; those who hear me now, have got ears to hear from!

subject: I voted for the Xbox
author: SUFFUR
body:
😲 Yes i did, as Burnout 3 works better on there for Comms and not so much glitching lol. But the 360 is better for Revenge.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when its going to run out?
